headline: Rabiul: Target to complete six-lane Dhaka-Sylhet highway by June 2029

members.title: Rabiul: Target to complete six-lane Dhaka-Sylhet highway by June 2029
members.lead: The government is targeting completion of the Dhaka-Sylhet highway's upgrade to six lanes by June 2029, Road Transport and Bridges, Railways and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam has said. “We are working with the target of completing the six-lane upgrade and opening the road to the public by June 2029,” he said while speaking to journalists on Saturday afternoon after... members.lead: The highway is being upgraded into a six-lane road Details
